properties.name: krizaka.billing.base-url
properties.description: Internal base URL of the billing service.

properties.name: krizaka.billing.connect-timeout
properties.description: How long a call waits for the connection; tight, billing sits on the interactive path.

properties.name: krizaka.billing.enabled
properties.description: Whether the HTTP adapters are wired instead of the no-op ones. Off by default: a fresh clone runs the whole stack without billing.

properties.name: krizaka.billing.read-timeout
properties.description: How long a call waits for the response; tight, a slow billing service must degrade through the fail modes rather than hold a request open.

properties.name: krizaka.billing.service-secret
properties.description: Shared HS256 identity secret the SERVICE token of every call is signed with, which /internal/v1/** requires. Required when billing is enabled.
